title: 大型鋼構防蝕塗裝~Protective coating of large steel structures
focus: 依腐蝕環境選擇塗裝系統，以表面處理、露點與膜厚控制施工品質，並以狀態評估決定局部修補或全面重塗~Selecting coating systems by corrosivity, controlling quality through surface preparation, dew point and film thickness, and using condition surveys to choose spot repair or full repainting
summary: 從大氣腐蝕環境與 ISO 12944 腐蝕性分級出發，說明鋅底漆、中塗與面漆的防蝕機制、噴砂清潔度與錨紋、露點與施工環境、構件細部與邊緣膜厚、濕膜與乾膜厚度驗收、附著力檢測、劣化分級與維護策略，並以舊金山金門大橋的持續修補、蘇格蘭福斯鐵橋首次全面重塗與艾菲爾鐵塔每約七年一次的重塗為實例。~Starting from atmospheric corrosivity and the ISO 12944 categories, explain how zinc primers, intermediate coats and topcoats protect steel, then cover blast-cleaning grade and surface profile, dew point and site conditions, detailing and edge film build, wet- and dry-film thickness acceptance, adhesion testing, degradation rating and maintenance strategy, using the continuous touch-up of San Francisco's Golden Gate Bridge, the first full repaint of Scotland's Forth Bridge and the roughly seven-yearly repainting of the Eiffel Tower.

units.anchor: ISO 12944 腐蝕性類別~ISO 12944 corrosivity category
units.title: 腐蝕環境與腐蝕性分級~Corrosive environments and corrosivity categories
units.mechanism: 鋼材在大氣中腐蝕需要水膜與氧，速率主要取決於表面潮濕時間、氯鹽沉積與硫化物；海邊的霧與鹽風會讓腐蝕速率比內陸高出數倍。ISO 12944 依碳鋼第一年腐蝕損失把環境分成 C1 至 C5 與 CX 等類別，作為選擇塗裝系統與耐久等級的依據。同一座結構內也有微環境差異：遮蔽的下翼板、積水的接頭與縫隙、浪花飛濺區，往往比外露迎風面腐蝕更快。金門大橋的維護人員就描述他們要對抗風、海氣與霧造成的鋼材腐蝕。~Steel corrodes in air when a moisture film and oxygen are present, at a rate governed mainly by time of wetness, chloride deposition and sulfur compounds; coastal fog and salt-laden wind can multiply the rate several times over inland values. ISO 12944 groups environments into categories C1 to C5 and CX by the first-year corrosion loss of carbon steel, the basis for choosing coating systems and durability ranges. A single structure also has microclimates: sheltered bottom flanges, water-trapping joints and crevices, and splash zones often corrode faster than exposed windward faces. Golden Gate Bridge maintenance crews describe battling wind, sea air and fog that corrode the steel.
units.model: 大氣腐蝕長期損失 d(t) = r·t^b。取 C4 環境第一年損失 r = 60 μm、碳鋼指數 b = 0.523：25 年 d = 60×25^0.523 ≈ 60×5.38 ≈ 323 μm，每面約 0.32 mm；若誤用線性外推 60×25 = 1,500 μm，會高估約 4.6 倍。數值為教學假設。~Long-term atmospheric loss d(t) = r·t^b. With a C4 first-year loss r = 60 μm and a carbon-steel exponent b = 0.523, 25 years gives d = 60×25^0.523 ≈ 60×5.38 ≈ 323 μm, about 0.32 mm per face; extrapolating linearly as 60×25 = 1,500 μm would overstate it about 4.6 times. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以現場暴露試片（碳鋼與鋅試片）量測一年腐蝕損失，或依鄰近海岸距離、氯鹽沉積與濕度資料評估腐蝕性類別；同時在結構上標出遮蔽、積水與飛濺等高風險區，分區指定塗裝系統。~Measure one-year corrosion loss on site with exposed steel and zinc coupons, or assess the corrosivity category from distance to the coast, chloride deposition and humidity data; mark sheltered, water-trapping and splash zones on the structure as high-risk areas and assign coating systems by zone.
units.failure: 若整座海邊橋梁以單一較低的腐蝕性類別設計塗裝，迎風外露面表現尚可，但下翼板、支承附近與排水不良的節點在數年內就出現大面積生鏽與層狀剝落，修補需要搭設困難的懸吊架。~Designing a whole coastal bridge's coating for one lower corrosivity category leaves exposed windward faces fine, but bottom flanges, areas near bearings and poorly drained nodes rust widely and delaminate within a few years, and repair needs difficult suspended access.
units.misconception: 同一座橋的所有部位都處在相同的腐蝕環境中。~Every part of a bridge sits in the same corrosive environment.
units.practice: 塗裝規格書應以腐蝕性分區圖指定每一區的系統、總膜厚與耐久等級，並把高風險區列為加強塗裝（例如加一道中塗或條塗）；分區圖由結構與塗裝工程師共同簽認。~The coating specification should use a corrosivity zoning drawing to assign system, total film thickness and durability range to each zone, with high-risk zones upgraded, for example by an extra intermediate or stripe coat; structural and coating engineers sign the zoning drawing together.

units.anchor: 鋅底漆、中塗與面漆~Zinc primer, intermediate and topcoat
units.title: 多層塗裝系統的防蝕機制~How multi-coat systems protect steel
units.mechanism: 大型鋼構常用三層系統：富鋅底漆以鋅粉的犧牲陽極作用保護鋼材，即使塗膜有小傷口，鋅也會先腐蝕；中塗（常為環氧）提供膜厚與阻隔，延長水氣與離子滲透到鋼面的路徑；面漆（聚氨酯、壓克力等）抵抗紫外線並保持顏色。金門大橋在移除原有含鉛塗料後改用無機鋅矽酸鹽底漆加面漆；艾菲爾鐵塔每次重塗也採防鏽底漆、防鏽加強層與面漆三層；福斯鐵橋首次全面重塗則使用源自北海石油工業的三層系統。~Large steel structures commonly use a three-coat system: a zinc-rich primer protects steel sacrificially, with zinc corroding first even at small breaks in the film; an intermediate coat, often epoxy, adds thickness and barrier, lengthening the path for moisture and ions to reach the steel; and a topcoat such as polyurethane or acrylic resists ultraviolet light and holds colour. After removing its original lead-based paint, the Golden Gate Bridge moved to an inorganic zinc silicate primer with a topcoat; each Eiffel Tower campaign applies an anti-rust primer, an anti-rust reinforcement coat and a finish coat; and the Forth Bridge's first full repaint used a three-coat system derived from the North Sea oil industry.
units.model: 理論塗佈率 = 固含量體積比×1,000/乾膜厚（m²/L）。中塗固含量 80%、乾膜 150 μm：0.8×1,000/150 ≈ 5.33 m²/L，對應濕膜 150/0.8 = 187.5 μm；桁架構件噴塗損耗取 40%，實際約 5.33×0.6 ≈ 3.2 m²/L。數值為教學假設。~Theoretical spreading rate = volume solids×1,000/dry film thickness (m²/L). An intermediate coat with 80% volume solids at 150 μm dry gives 0.8×1,000/150 ≈ 5.33 m²/L, requiring a wet film of 150/0.8 = 187.5 μm; with 40% spray loss on lattice members, the practical rate is about 5.33×0.6 ≈ 3.2 m²/L. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 核對每一層產品的技術資料（固含量、建議膜厚、覆塗間隔、相容性）與規格書系統是否一致，並要求同一供應商提供整套系統的相容性證明；系統若需達到高耐久等級，應有實驗室加速試驗或實績證明。~Check each product's data sheet (volume solids, recommended thickness, recoat window, compatibility) against the specified system and require the supplier to certify compatibility of the whole system; where a high durability range is claimed, require laboratory accelerated test results or a service record.
units.failure: 若在富鋅底漆上直接塗上不相容的面漆，或把無機鋅矽酸鹽塗得過厚而產生龜裂，整個系統會從底漆層剝離；更換面漆品牌卻沒有確認相容性，也可能造成層間附著不良與起泡。~Applying an incompatible topcoat directly over zinc-rich primer, or building inorganic zinc silicate too thick so it mud-cracks, lets the whole system delaminate at the primer; switching topcoat brands without checking compatibility can also cause poor intercoat adhesion and blistering.
units.misconception: 塗裝主要是為了顏色與外觀，防蝕效果與塗層層次無關。~Coatings are mainly for colour and looks, and the number of layers does not matter for protection.
units.practice: 塗裝系統應以整套方式指定與採購，不允許承包商任意混用不同廠牌的單一層；任何替代產品都須提出相容性與性能證明，並經業主的塗裝顧問核准後才可使用。~Specify and procure the coating as a complete system and do not let contractors mix single coats from different makers; any substitute product needs evidence of compatibility and performance and approval by the owner's coating consultant before use.

units.anchor: Sa 2½ 噴砂與錨紋~Sa 2½ blast and anchor profile
units.title: 表面處理、清潔度與露點~Surface preparation, cleanliness and dew point
units.mechanism: 塗裝壽命很大部分在塗第一層之前就已決定：噴砂必須除去軋鋼皮、鏽與舊塗層，達到 ISO 8501-1 規定的清潔等級（例如 Sa 2½），並形成適當深度的錨紋讓底漆咬合；表面殘留的可溶性鹽類會在塗膜下吸水起泡，因此海邊結構還要檢測氯鹽。施工時鋼面溫度必須高於露點至少 3°C，否則表面凝結的薄水膜會使新噴砂面立即返鏽，並降低附著力。~Much of a coating's life is settled before the first coat: blasting must remove mill scale, rust and old coatings to the cleanliness grade of ISO 8501-1, for example Sa 2½, and create an anchor profile deep enough for the primer to key into; soluble salts left on the surface draw water under the film and cause blisters, so coastal structures are also tested for chloride. During work the steel temperature must be at least 3°C above the dew point, or a thin condensed film will flash-rust freshly blasted steel and reduce adhesion.
units.model: Magnus 露點：γ = ln(RH) + 17.62T/(243.12 + T)，T_d = 243.12γ/(17.62 − γ)。氣溫 20°C、相對濕度 85%：γ = ln0.85 + 17.62×20/263.12 ≈ −0.163 + 1.339 = 1.177，T_d ≈ 243.12×1.177/16.443 ≈ 17.4°C；鋼面須 ≥ 20.4°C，若量到 19°C 就不得施工。數值為教學假設。~Magnus dew point: γ = ln(RH) + 17.62T/(243.12 + T) and T_d = 243.12γ/(17.62 − γ). At 20°C air and 85% relative humidity, γ = ln0.85 + 17.62×20/263.12 ≈ −0.163 + 1.339 = 1.177, so T_d ≈ 243.12×1.177/16.443 ≈ 17.4°C; the steel must be at least 20.4°C, so a reading of 19°C means no coating. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 噴砂後以 ISO 8501-1 標準照片比對清潔度、以複製膠帶或比對規量測錨紋深度、以膠帶測試灰塵量，並以表面鹽分檢測確認氯鹽低於規格值；每次塗裝前與施工中定時記錄氣溫、濕度、鋼面溫度與露點，不合格時停止施工。~After blasting, compare cleanliness with ISO 8501-1 reference photographs, measure profile with replica tape or a comparator, check dust by tape test and confirm chloride below the specified limit by surface salt testing; before and during each coat, log air temperature, humidity, steel temperature and dew point at set intervals, stopping work when out of limits.
units.failure: 清晨在接近露點的鋼面上噴砂並立刻塗底漆，看似完成，數月後塗膜下出現點狀返鏽與起泡；海邊結構若只看清潔度照片而不測鹽分，殘留氯鹽會讓新塗膜在一兩年內大面積起泡。~Blasting and priming early in the morning on steel near the dew point looks finished, but spot rust and blisters appear under the film within months; on coastal structures, judging only by cleanliness photographs without salt testing lets residual chloride blister large areas of new coating within a year or two.
units.misconception: 只要表面看起來是亮白的金屬，就可以直接塗裝。~If the surface looks like bright white metal, it is ready to coat.
units.practice: 把表面處理完成後的檢查列為塗底漆前的停留點，由檢驗員簽認清潔度、錨紋、鹽分與環境紀錄；噴砂面須在規定時間內塗上底漆，超過時間或出現返鏽就必須重新處理。~Make post-preparation inspection a hold point before priming, with the inspector signing for cleanliness, profile, salts and environmental records; blasted steel must be primed within the specified time, and any surface that exceeds it or flash-rusts must be re-prepared.

units.anchor: 銳邊、隙縫與排水孔~Sharp edges, crevices and drain holes
units.title: 構件細部與可塗裝性~Detailing for coatability
units.mechanism: 塗料在銳邊因表面張力而縮離，邊緣膜厚常只有平面的一半甚至更少，所以生鏽多從邊緣、螺栓頭與焊道開始。良好的防蝕細部包括：把銳邊磨圓、避免無法塗裝的窄縫與背對背角鋼、在可能積水處設排水孔、讓箱形構件完全密封或可進入維護，並預留塗裝工具與人員的作業空間。金門大橋的鐵工必須拆下板件，才能讓塗裝工進入柱與弦桿內部作業；該橋自 1970 年起也以高強度螺栓逐步取代鉚釘。~Paint pulls back from sharp edges by surface tension, so edge film is often half or less of the flat-surface thickness, which is why rust usually starts at edges, bolt heads and welds. Good anti-corrosion detailing rounds sharp edges, avoids uncoatable narrow gaps and back-to-back angles, adds drain holes where water could collect, makes box members either fully sealed or accessible, and leaves working space for tools and painters. On the Golden Gate Bridge, ironworkers must remove plates so painters can reach the interiors of columns and chords, and since 1970 rivets have progressively been replaced with high-strength bolts.
units.model: 系統總乾膜 285 μm，銳邊若只保留約 40%，邊緣膜厚約 285×0.4 = 114 μm；先以刷塗條塗增加約 100 μm，邊緣達 214 μm；若改把邊緣磨圓、保留率提高到約 70%，即使不條塗也有約 200 μm。數值為教學假設。~With a total dry film of 285 μm, a sharp edge retaining only about 40% gets about 285×0.4 = 114 μm; a brushed stripe coat adding about 100 μm brings it to 214 μm, while rounding the edge to raise retention to about 70% gives about 200 μm even without a stripe coat. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 製造時檢查邊緣是否依規格磨圓、焊道與焊濺物是否處理到規定等級；塗裝後在邊緣、螺栓與焊道附近加測膜厚，並確認條塗已在每一層之間完成；設計審查時檢查是否有積水、無法塗裝或無法檢查的細部。~During fabrication, check that edges are rounded and welds and spatter dressed to the specified grade; after coating, take extra thickness readings at edges, bolts and welds and confirm stripe coats were applied between layers; in design review, look for details that trap water or cannot be coated or inspected.
units.failure: 背對背角鋼或密貼板件之間的窄縫無法塗裝，水氣滲入後鏽蝕膨脹，把板件撐開並拉斷鉚釘或螺栓；未設排水孔的箱形構件內部長年積水，外觀完好但內部截面已嚴重減少。~Narrow gaps between back-to-back angles or contacting plates cannot be coated; moisture enters, rust swells and pries the plates apart, breaking rivets or bolts; box members without drain holes hold water for years, looking sound outside while their interior section is badly reduced.
units.misconception: 塗裝問題只能靠塗料品質解決，與結構細部無關。~Coating problems are solved only by better paint, not by structural detailing.
units.practice: 結構設計階段就要邀請塗裝顧問審查細部，把可塗裝性與可檢查性列入設計審查清單；箱形構件須明確標示為密封（並檢查焊縫氣密）或可進入（並設置人孔與照明），不可介於兩者之間。~Invite the coating consultant to review details at the structural design stage and add coatability and inspectability to the design review checklist; box members must be clearly designated either sealed, with airtight welds checked, or accessible, with manholes and lighting, never something in between.

units.anchor: 圍封、除濕與覆塗間隔~Containment, dehumidification and recoat windows
units.title: 現場施工環境與工序控制~Site environment and sequence control
units.mechanism: 大型既有結構的維護塗裝是在高空、風雨與交通中進行：需要搭設包覆式施工架或吊籃，以圍封收集噴砂粉塵與舊塗層碎屑，必要時以除濕機控制施工環境；每一層須在最短與最長覆塗間隔內完成下一層，否則附著不良。艾菲爾鐵塔一次重塗需 18 個月到三年以上，約 50 名塗裝工使用總長約 55 km 的安全索，並以防護網收集漆片；福斯鐵橋 2002 年起的首次全面重塗覆蓋約 255,000 m²、用漆約 240,000 L。~Maintenance painting of large existing structures happens at height, in wind, rain and traffic: encapsulated scaffolds or cradles are needed to contain blast dust and old coating debris, with dehumidifiers controlling the environment where needed, and each coat must be overcoated within its minimum and maximum recoat window or adhesion suffers. An Eiffel Tower campaign takes 18 months to over three years, with about 50 painters using about 55 km of safety lines and nets catching paint flakes; the Forth Bridge's first full repaint from 2002 covered about 255,000 m² with about 240,000 L of paint.
units.model: 以福斯鐵橋公開數字粗估單位用量 240,000/255,000 ≈ 0.94 L/m²。若假設三層總乾膜 450 μm、平均固含量 75%，理論用量 0.45/0.75 = 0.60 L/m²，推得包含損耗的比例約 1 − 0.60/0.94 ≈ 36%。膜厚與固含量為教學假設，不代表該工程的實際系統。~A rough unit consumption from the Forth Bridge's published figures is 240,000/255,000 ≈ 0.94 L/m². Assuming a three-coat total of 450 μm dry at 75% average volume solids, the theoretical use is 0.45/0.75 = 0.60 L/m², implying losses of about 1 − 0.60/0.94 ≈ 36%. Film thickness and solids are teaching assumptions, not that project's actual system.
units.verify: 每日記錄各區的塗裝層次、產品批號、施工時間與環境數據，並比對覆塗間隔；以材料消耗量與塗裝面積計算實際單位用量，若明顯低於理論值，表示膜厚可能不足，應立即加測乾膜厚。~Log daily the coat, product batch, application time and environmental data for each zone and check recoat windows; compute actual unit consumption from material used and area coated, and if it falls well below the theoretical value, suspect thin film and take extra thickness readings at once.
units.failure: 圍封不完整讓含鉛舊漆碎屑落入河道或人行道，工程被環保單位勒令停工；超過最長覆塗間隔才塗面漆，層間附著不良，數年後面漆大片剝落，必須再次全面處理。~Incomplete containment lets lead-bearing debris fall into the river or onto walkways and environmental authorities halt the work; topcoating after the maximum recoat window leaves poor intercoat adhesion, so large sheets of topcoat peel within a few years and everything must be redone.
units.misconception: 只要天氣晴朗，任何時間都可以進行下一層塗裝。~In fine weather, the next coat can be applied at any time.
units.practice: 施工計畫須包含圍封與廢棄物處理、環境監測、每一層的覆塗間隔與天候停工條件，並由業主核准；高空與圍封施工涉及墜落與粉塵風險，作業許可須依職業安全規定辦理，本課只說明品質控制邏輯。~The work plan must cover containment and waste handling, environmental monitoring, recoat windows for each coat and weather stop criteria, approved by the owner; work at height and inside containment carries fall and dust hazards and needs permits under occupational-safety rules, and this course explains quality-control logic only.

units.anchor: 濕膜梳與乾膜測厚儀~Wet-film comb and dry-film gauge
units.title: 濕膜與乾膜厚度控制~Wet- and dry-film thickness control
units.mechanism: 膜厚是塗裝規格中最直接可量測的品質指標：太薄則阻隔不足、提早生鏽，太厚則可能龜裂、殘留溶劑或附著不良。施工中以濕膜梳即時檢查，由固含量換算乾膜；乾燥後以磁性或渦電流測厚儀量測乾膜厚，在粗糙的噴砂面上要依 ISO 19840 扣除粗糙度修正值。驗收常採「80-20 規則」：平均值不低於標稱膜厚、低於標稱值的讀數不超過 20%，且沒有任何讀數低於標稱值的 80%，同時不得超過產品允許的最大膜厚。~Film thickness is the most directly measurable quality indicator in a coating specification: too thin gives poor barrier and early rust, too thick can crack, trap solvent or adhere poorly. During application a wet-film comb gives immediate checks, converted to dry film by volume solids; after drying, magnetic or eddy-current gauges measure dry film, with a roughness correction deducted on blasted surfaces per ISO 19840. Acceptance commonly uses the 80-20 rule: the mean is at least the nominal thickness, no more than 20% of readings fall below nominal, no reading is below 80% of nominal, and the product's maximum thickness is not exceeded.
units.model: 標稱乾膜 285 μm，最低個別值 0.8×285 = 228 μm。某區 20 個讀數中有 3 個介於 240 與 280 μm（15%，≤ 20%），但另有 1 個為 220 μm < 228 μm，該區判不合格，須找出低膜厚範圍補塗；粗糙度中等時每個讀數先扣約 25 μm 修正值。數值為教學假設。~For a nominal dry film of 285 μm the minimum single reading is 0.8×285 = 228 μm. If 3 of 20 readings in an area lie between 240 and 280 μm (15%, within 20%) but one reads 220 μm < 228 μm, the area fails and the thin zone must be found and recoated; on a medium profile, about 25 μm is first deducted from each reading as the roughness correction. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 測厚儀每天以標準片在相同粗糙度的試板上校正，量測點依 ISO 19840 的抽樣數量分布於平面、邊緣與接頭；結果以位置圖記錄，低於標準的區域以標記圈出補塗後重新量測。~Calibrate gauges daily with standard shims on a test panel of the same roughness, distribute readings per the ISO 19840 sampling plan over flats, edges and joints, map the results by location, and circle, recoat and re-measure any area below standard.
units.failure: 為了趕工一次厚噴無機鋅底漆，局部膜厚超過上限而龜裂，面漆覆蓋後看不出來，幾年後龜裂處先起泡剝落；反之只在平面量膜厚，邊緣與螺栓處偏薄卻未被發現。~Spraying inorganic zinc primer thick in one pass to save time pushes local thickness past its limit so it cracks, hidden once topcoated until those areas blister and flake years later; conversely, measuring only flat areas misses thin film at edges and bolts.
units.misconception: 塗膜越厚越好，超過規定厚度只會更耐久。~The thicker the film the better; exceeding the specified thickness only adds durability.
units.practice: 規格書要同時規定最小與最大膜厚、量測方法與抽樣數量，並要求每一層都量測與記錄，而不是只量最後總膜厚；膜厚紀錄是付款與保固的依據，須由獨立檢驗員簽認。~The specification must set both minimum and maximum thickness, the measuring method and sampling, and require each coat, not just the final total, to be measured and recorded; thickness records support payment and warranty and must be signed by an independent inspector.

units.anchor: 拉拔附著力試驗~Pull-off adhesion test
units.title: 附著力與塗膜缺陷檢測~Adhesion and film-defect testing
units.mechanism: 膜厚合格不代表塗層黏得住。附著力常以 ISO 4624 拉拔試驗量測：把金屬拉拔頭黏在塗膜上，切開周圍塗膜，以拉拔器施力直到破壞，記錄破壞強度與破壞位置（底材與底漆之間、層間或塗層內聚破壞）。破壞位置往往比數值更有意義：若破壞在底漆與鋼面之間，代表表面處理有問題；若在層間，則可能是覆塗間隔或污染。塗膜還要以目視與針孔檢測找出流掛、乾噴、針孔與漏塗。~Correct thickness does not prove the coating sticks. Adhesion is commonly measured by the ISO 4624 pull-off test: a metal dolly is glued to the film, the coating around it scored, and a tester pulls until failure, recording the stress and where it failed, between steel and primer, between coats or cohesively within a coat. The failure location often matters more than the value: failure at the primer–steel interface points to surface preparation, failure between coats to recoat timing or contamination. The film is also checked visually and with holiday detectors for runs, dry spray, pinholes and misses.
units.model: 拉拔強度 σ = F/A。拉拔頭直徑 20 mm，A = π×10² ≈ 314 mm²，破壞力 F = 2.2 kN：σ = 2,200/314 ≈ 7.0 MPa。若規格要求 ≥ 5 MPa，數值合格；但若破壞面 60% 在底漆與鋼面之間，仍應檢討表面處理。數值為教學假設。~Pull-off stress σ = F/A. A 20 mm dolly has A = π×10² ≈ 314 mm², and a failure force of F = 2.2 kN gives σ = 2,200/314 ≈ 7.0 MPa. Against a specified 5 MPa this passes, yet if 60% of the fracture lies between primer and steel, surface preparation should still be reviewed. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 拉拔試驗在代表性試板或結構上的指定位置進行，記錄黏著劑種類、養護時間、拉拔速率、破壞強度與各破壞模式的百分比；試驗點完成後須依程序修補。針孔檢測則依塗層厚度選擇低壓濕海綿或高壓火花檢測，電壓依規格設定。~Run pull-off tests on representative panels or designated locations on the structure, recording adhesive, cure time, pull rate, failure stress and the percentage of each failure mode, and repair test spots by procedure; for holiday detection choose low-voltage wet sponge or high-voltage spark by film thickness, at the specified voltage.
units.failure: 附著力試驗只在工廠試板上做一次，現場在潮濕或有灰塵的狀態下塗裝，實際附著力遠低於試板，塗層在第一個冬季就成片剝落；高壓針孔檢測電壓過高，反而擊穿合格塗膜造成新缺陷。~Testing adhesion once on shop panels while site coats go on damp or dusty steel leaves actual adhesion far below the panels, and the coating peels in sheets the first winter; setting high-voltage holiday detection too high punctures sound film and creates new defects.
units.misconception: 只要膜厚量測合格，就可以確認塗裝品質良好。~If film thickness passes, coating quality is confirmed.
units.practice: 在大面積施工前先做一塊現場樣板，依完整程序施工並做附著力與膜厚驗收，作為之後所有區域的品質基準；檢驗結果與樣板位置記錄在交接文件中，保固爭議時可以回溯。~Before large-scale work, make a site reference area applied by the full procedure and accepted for adhesion and thickness as the quality benchmark for all later areas; record the results and location in the handover documents so warranty disputes can be traced.

units.anchor: ISO 4628 生鏽等級~ISO 4628 rust grade
units.title: 狀態評估與劣化分級~Condition surveys and degradation rating
units.mechanism: 維護決策要以量化的狀態評估為基礎：ISO 4628 以標準圖比對生鏽、起泡、龜裂、剝落與粉化程度，例如生鏽等級 Ri 1 至 Ri 5 對應約 0.05% 至 40% 至 50% 的生鏽面積。金門大橋的塗裝工作依檢查結果決定在哪裡腐蝕正在擴大；艾菲爾鐵塔每次重塗也從找出並暴露最嚴重的腐蝕區開始，並估計兩次重塗之間約有 15 t 塗料被侵蝕。把評估結果畫在構件分區圖上，就能看出劣化是隨機分布還是集中於特定細部。~Maintenance decisions should rest on quantified condition surveys: ISO 4628 compares rusting, blistering, cracking, flaking and chalking with reference images, rust grades Ri 1 to Ri 5 corresponding to about 0.05% up to 40 to 50% rusted area. Golden Gate Bridge painting is planned from inspections that show where corrosion is advancing, and each Eiffel Tower campaign begins by finding and exposing the worst corrosion, with about 15 t of paint estimated to erode between campaigns. Mapping survey results onto member zones shows whether deterioration is random or concentrated at particular details.
units.model: 艾菲爾鐵塔每次約用 60 t 塗料、兩次之間約 15 t 被侵蝕，即約 25%。換算面積 250,000 m²：15,000 kg/250,000 m² = 60 g/m²；若乾膜密度取 1,500 kg/m³，約等於 40 μm 厚，以約 7 年計平均每年侵蝕約 5.7 μm。密度為教學假設。~Each Eiffel Tower campaign uses about 60 t of paint, and about 15 t erodes between campaigns, about 25%. Over 250,000 m², 15,000 kg/250,000 m² = 60 g/m²; taking a dry-film density of 1,500 kg/m³, that is about 40 μm, or about 5.7 μm a year over roughly 7 years. The density is a teaching assumption.
units.verify: 訂定固定的檢查分區與照片位置，每次調查以相同光線與距離拍照，並以 ISO 4628 標準圖評級；抽樣量測剩餘膜厚與附著力，與原始施工紀錄比較，找出劣化最快的區域與原因。~Fix inspection zones and photo positions, photograph each survey with the same lighting and distance, and rate against ISO 4628 reference images; sample remaining film thickness and adhesion and compare with the original construction records to find where and why deterioration is fastest.
units.failure: 若只以「看起來還好」作為判斷，等到大面積生鏽才處理，鏽層已滲入塗膜下方，局部修補不再可行，只能全面去除重塗，成本與交通管制時間都大幅增加。~Judging only by whether it still looks fine and acting once rust is widespread lets corrosion creep beneath the film, so spot repair is no longer viable and full removal and repainting become necessary at much greater cost and closure time.
units.misconception: 塗層表面還有顏色，就表示防蝕功能仍然完好。~If the coating still shows colour, its protection is intact.
units.practice: 業主應建立以構件分區為單位的塗裝狀態資料庫，固定週期更新評級，並以評級觸發維護行動（例如某區達到 Ri 2 時安排局部修補）；評級人員須受過標準圖比對訓練，以減少主觀差異。~The owner should keep a coating-condition database by member zone, update ratings on a fixed cycle and let ratings trigger action, for example spot repair when a zone reaches Ri 2; raters must be trained on the reference images to reduce subjective scatter.

units.anchor: 維護塗裝決策點~Maintenance-painting decision point
units.title: 局部修補、覆塗或全面重塗~Spot repair, overcoating or full repainting
units.mechanism: 維護策略有三種：局部修補只處理生鏽點，成本低但須及早進行；覆塗是在附著良好的舊塗層上加塗，延長壽命；全面重塗則把舊塗層全部去除，成本最高但可重建完整系統。金門大橋採持續修補，官方強調重塗不是每七年一次、也不是每年從頭塗到尾；它在 1965 年起移除含鉛塗料並改用鋅矽酸鹽系統，至 1995 年完成。福斯鐵橋在 1890 年通車後直到 2002 年才開始第一次全面重塗；艾菲爾鐵塔 2019 年起的第 20 次重塗首次包含局部除漆。~There are three maintenance strategies: spot repair treats only rusted spots, cheaply, but must be done early; overcoating adds coats over well-adhered old paint to extend its life; full repainting removes all old coating at the highest cost but rebuilds a complete system. The Golden Gate Bridge relies on continuous touch-up, and its owner stresses that it is neither repainted every seven years nor painted end to end each year; from 1965 it removed its lead-based paint for a zinc silicate system, a program completed in 1995. The Forth Bridge, opened in 1890, began its first full repaint only in 2002, and the Eiffel Tower's 20th campaign from 2019 included stripping parts of the structure for the first time.
units.model: 某區第 10 年達 Ri 2（約 0.5% 生鏽面積），若生鏽面積每 3 年加倍：0.5%×2⁴ = 8%，約在 10 + 4×3 = 22 年達 Ri 4。局部修補的經濟窗口約在第 10 至 13 年（Ri 2 至 Ri 3）；錯過後只能以覆塗或全面重塗處理。數值為教學假設。~A zone reaches Ri 2 (about 0.5% rusted area) in year 10; if rusted area doubles every 3 years, 0.5%×2⁴ = 8% is reached at about 10 + 4×3 = 22 years, Ri 4. The economic window for spot repair is roughly years 10 to 13 (Ri 2 to Ri 3); after that only overcoating or full repainting remain. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 選擇覆塗前，先在舊塗層上做附著力與相容性試驗區，確認舊系統可承受新塗層的收縮應力；選擇全面重塗前，檢測舊塗層是否含鉛或其他有害物質，以決定圍封與廢棄物處理等級。~Before overcoating, run adhesion and compatibility trial patches on the old coating to confirm it can carry the shrinkage stress of new coats; before full repainting, test old coatings for lead or other hazardous substances to set containment and waste-handling levels.
units.failure: 在附著力已不足的舊塗層上直接覆塗，新塗層的收縮把舊塗層一起拉起，整片剝落；錯過局部修補時機，原本只需處理數百平方公尺的生鏽點，演變成全面重塗。~Overcoating old paint that has already lost adhesion lets the new coat's shrinkage lift both layers off together in sheets; missing the spot-repair window turns a few hundred square metres of rust spots into a full repaint.
units.misconception: 大型鋼橋必須定期從一端塗到另一端，永不停止。~A large steel bridge must be painted continuously from one end to the other, forever.
units.practice: 維護計畫應以狀態評級、附著力與有害物質檢測為依據，逐區選擇修補、覆塗或全面重塗，並由業主的結構與塗裝工程師共同核定；重大重塗工程須評估施工架載重與交通影響，並取得相關主管機關核准。~The maintenance plan should choose spot repair, overcoat or full repaint zone by zone from condition ratings, adhesion and hazardous-material tests, approved jointly by the owner's structural and coating engineers; major repainting must assess scaffold loads and traffic impact and obtain the relevant authority approvals.

units.anchor: 塗裝履歷與色彩規格~Coating history and colour specification
units.title: 塗裝紀錄、環保要求與交接~Coating records, environmental rules and handover
units.mechanism: 大型鋼構的塗裝會經歷數十年與多個世代的產品與法規：金門大橋的原始塗料是約含 68% 紅丹膏的亞麻仁油含鉛漆，後來為了符合揮發性有機物空氣品質規定，在 1990 年把面漆由乙烯系改為壓克力乳膠；其國際橘的色彩規格也被精確記錄，由 Sherwin-Williams 供應塗料。交接文件要記錄每一區的系統、產品與批號、表面處理等級、膜厚圖、附著力試驗、環境紀錄與修補履歷，讓下一次維護知道底下是什麼。~Coatings on large steel structures span decades and several generations of products and regulations: the Golden Gate Bridge's original paint was a lead-based linseed-oil paint of about 68% red lead paste, and in 1990 its topcoat changed from vinyl to acrylic emulsion to meet air-quality rules on volatile organic compounds; its International Orange is precisely specified, with paint supplied by Sherwin-Williams. Handover documents must record, zone by zone, the system, products and batches, preparation grade, thickness maps, adhesion tests, environmental logs and repair history, so the next maintenance team knows what lies beneath.
units.model: 揮發性有機物排放 = 塗料量 × VOC 含量。100,000 L 塗料、VOC 300 g/L：100,000×300 = 30,000,000 g = 30 t；改用 100 g/L 的低 VOC 產品則為 10 t，減少三分之二，但須確認新產品的施工窗口與膜厚性能。數值為教學假設。~VOC emissions = paint volume × VOC content. 100,000 L of paint at 300 g/L releases 100,000×300 = 30,000,000 g = 30 t; switching to a 100 g/L low-VOC product gives 10 t, two thirds less, provided its application window and film performance are confirmed. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 交接前抽查數個分區，從現場標示追溯到產品批號、膜厚圖、附著力與環境紀錄，確認紀錄完整；檢查舊塗層有害物質調查報告與廢棄物處理文件是否歸檔，並確認色彩規格與產品編號已寫入維護手冊。~Before handover, sample several zones and trace site labels back to product batches, thickness maps, adhesion and environmental records to confirm completeness; check that hazardous-material surveys of old coatings and waste-disposal documents are filed, and that colour specifications and product codes are written into the maintenance manual.
units.failure: 若沒有紀錄舊塗層是否含鉛，後續維護時以一般噴砂方式處理，工人與周邊環境暴露在含鉛粉塵中，工程被迫停工並增加清理成本；不知道原系統成分而選錯修補漆，也會造成相容性問題。~Without records of whether old coatings contain lead, later maintenance may blast them conventionally, exposing workers and surroundings to lead dust, forcing a stop and adding clean-up cost; not knowing the original system can also lead to an incompatible repair paint.
units.misconception: 塗裝完成後，只要保存顏色編號就足以進行日後維護。~After coating, keeping the colour code is enough for future maintenance.
units.practice: 業主應維持專職或長期合約的塗裝維護團隊與塗裝履歷資料庫，金門大橋即有 28 名塗裝工、13 名鐵工等常設人員；所有新產品、法規變更與修補都更新到資料庫，並由塗裝主管定期審查維護計畫。~The owner should keep a dedicated or long-term coating maintenance team and a coating-history database, as the Golden Gate Bridge does with a standing crew including 28 painters and 13 ironworkers; every new product, regulatory change and repair is added to the database, and the chief painter reviews the maintenance plan periodically.

example: 設計練習：某海邊鋼桁架橋塗裝面積 50,000 m²，評估為 C5 環境（教學假設第一年碳鋼損失 100 μm）。(1) 不塗裝時 25 年每面損失約 100×25^0.523 ≈ 538 μm。(2) 系統：無機鋅底漆 75 μm（固含量 60%）、環氧中塗 150 μm（80%）、聚氨酯面漆 60 μm（65%），總乾膜 285 μm。(3) 理論用量：50,000×75/(0.6×1,000) = 6,250 L、50,000×150/(0.8×1,000) = 9,375 L、50,000×60/(0.65×1,000) ≈ 4,615 L，合計約 20,240 L；損耗取 30%，採購約 20,240/0.7 ≈ 28,900 L，約 0.58 L/m²。(4) 施工時氣溫 20°C、濕度 85%，露點約 17.4°C，鋼面須 ≥ 20.4°C。(5) 驗收：最低個別讀數 0.8×285 = 228 μm。(6) 若改變一個輸入：飛濺區改列 CX 而加一道 150 μm 環氧中塗，該層理論用量再增加 9,375 L（含損耗約 13,400 L），總乾膜 435 μm。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際工程。~Design exercise: a coastal steel truss bridge has 50,000 m² to coat in a C5 environment (teaching assumption: first-year steel loss 100 μm). (1) Uncoated, each face would lose about 100×25^0.523 ≈ 538 μm in 25 years. (2) System: inorganic zinc primer 75 μm (60% volume solids), epoxy intermediate 150 μm (80%) and polyurethane topcoat 60 μm (65%), 285 μm dry in total. (3) Theoretical volumes: 50,000×75/(0.6×1,000) = 6,250 L, 50,000×150/(0.8×1,000) = 9,375 L and 50,000×60/(0.65×1,000) ≈ 4,615 L, about 20,240 L in total; with 30% loss, about 20,240/0.7 ≈ 28,900 L is bought, about 0.58 L/m². (4) At 20°C and 85% humidity the dew point is about 17.4°C, so the steel must be at least 20.4°C. (5) Acceptance: the minimum single reading is 0.8×285 = 228 μm. (6) Changing one input: classifying splash zones as CX and adding a 150 μm epoxy coat there adds 9,375 L theoretical for that coat (about 13,400 L with losses) and raises total dry film to 435 μm. Values are teaching assumptions, not any real project.
history: 大型鋼構的防蝕塗裝長期以含鉛塗料為主：1889 年完工的艾菲爾鐵塔自 1899 年後大致每七年重塗一次，至今已 20 次；1937 年通車的金門大橋最初則使用以紅丹與亞麻仁油調製的含鉛塗料。1960 年代起，金門大橋因腐蝕開始移除含鉛塗料並改用無機鋅矽酸鹽底漆系統，1995 年完成，並因空氣品質法規改用水性面漆；福斯鐵橋則在 2002 年起進行首次全面重塗，採用源自北海石油工業的三層系統。這些案例顯示塗裝系統、表面處理、環境法規與持續維護團隊必須一起規劃。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。~Protective coating of large steel structures long relied on lead-based paints: the Eiffel Tower, completed in 1889, has been repainted roughly every seven years since 1899, 20 times so far, while the Golden Gate Bridge, opened in 1937, began with a lead-based paint of red lead in linseed oil. From the 1960s, corrosion led the Golden Gate Bridge to remove its lead paint for an inorganic zinc silicate primer system, completed in 1995, with water-borne topcoats adopted under air-quality rules; the Forth Bridge began its first full repaint in 2002 with a three-coat system derived from the North Sea oil industry. These cases show that coating systems, surface preparation, environmental regulation and a standing maintenance team must be planned together. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.
facts: 金門大橋原始塗料為含鉛底漆與面漆，含鉛塗料移除計畫於 1995 年完成~The Golden Gate Bridge was first painted with lead primer and topcoat, and the lead-paint removal program was completed in 1995
金門大橋原含鉛漆約含 68% 紅丹膏，以亞麻仁油為載體~The Golden Gate Bridge's original lead paint was about 68% red lead paste in a linseed oil carrier
金門大橋 1990 年為符合 VOC 空氣品質規定，面漆由乙烯系改為壓克力乳膠~In 1990 the Golden Gate Bridge topcoat changed from vinyl to acrylic emulsion to meet VOC air-quality rules
金門大橋常設 28 名塗裝工、5 名塗裝助手、13 名鐵工與 3 名領班鐵工~The Golden Gate Bridge keeps 28 painters, 5 painter laborers, 13 ironworkers and 3 pusher ironworkers
金門大橋國際橘的 CMYK 為 C 0%、M 69%、Y 100%、K 6%~Golden Gate Bridge International Orange is CMYK C 0%, M 69%, Y 100%, K 6%
福斯鐵橋首次全面重塗涵蓋約 255,000 m²，用漆約 240,000 L~The Forth Bridge's first full repaint covered about 255,000 m² using about 240,000 L of paint
艾菲爾鐵塔 136 年間重塗 20 次，每次約 60 t 塗料、約 250,000 m²，約 50 名塗裝工~The Eiffel Tower has been repainted 20 times in 136 years, each time with about 60 t of paint over about 250,000 m² by about 50 painters
艾菲爾鐵塔兩次重塗之間估計約有 15 t 塗料被侵蝕~About 15 t of paint is estimated to erode from the Eiffel Tower between campaigns
ISO 12944 中 C5 環境碳鋼第一年腐蝕損失約 80 至 200 μm~In ISO 12944, C5 environments correspond to a first-year carbon-steel loss of about 80 to 200 μm

timeline.event: 艾菲爾鐵塔在此次重塗後採用約每七年一次的重塗週期~After this campaign the Eiffel Tower adopts a repainting cycle of about every seven years
金門大橋移除原有含鉛塗料，改用無機鋅矽酸鹽底漆系統~The Golden Gate Bridge removes its original lead-based paint and adopts an inorganic zinc silicate primer system
金門大橋為符合 VOC 規定把面漆改為壓克力乳膠~The Golden Gate Bridge switches its topcoat to acrylic emulsion to meet VOC rules
福斯鐵橋進行通車以來首次全面重塗，覆蓋約 255,000 m²~The Forth Bridge undergoes its first full repaint since opening, covering about 255,000 m²
艾菲爾鐵塔第 20 次重塗開始，首次包含局部除去舊漆~The Eiffel Tower's 20th repainting campaign begins, for the first time including stripping of parts of the structure

codes: ISO 12944 色漆與清漆—以保護塗裝系統防止鋼結構腐蝕~ISO 12944 Paints and varnishes — Corrosion protection of steel structures by protective paint systems
ISO 8501-1 塗裝前鋼材表面處理—表面清潔度目視評估~ISO 8501-1 Preparation of steel substrates before application of paints — Visual assessment of surface cleanliness
ISO 19840 粗糙表面上乾膜厚度的量測與驗收~ISO 19840 Measurement of, and acceptance criteria for, the thickness of dry films on rough surfaces
ISO 4624 色漆與清漆—附著力拉拔試驗~ISO 4624 Paints and varnishes — Pull-off test for adhesion
